title: Bat-filled structures smell different from the Red Pyramid

tellings.quote: We've been in Mustaba 17 that is filled with bats. We've been in the tomb of the birds that is filled with bats.

plain: A researcher named Geoffrey Drumm, who explores ancient Egyptian sites, says his team has been inside Mastaba 17, a flat-topped ancient tomb, and the Tomb of the Birds at Saqqara, both full of bats. He says those places smell different from the Red Pyramid, a large pyramid nearby, which for him suggests something else explains the pyramid's smell.
